plugin.name: Psi-Ops Fusion Fix
ResX.description: Width in pixels. Zero selects the desktop resolution. Restart required.
ResY.description: Height in pixels. Zero selects the desktop resolution. Restart required.
FOVFactor.description: Multiplies the corrected camera field of view. 1.0 keeps the intended framing; larger values widen the view. Applies to the next camera update.
SkipIntro.description: Skip the publisher, middleware and legal movies at startup. Story movies still play. Restart required.
menu.restoredefaultshelp: Resets this page to its defaults.
menu.restartwarning: The game must be restarted to apply settings.
menu.FOVFactor.help: Changes the camera width. 1.0 keeps the original framing.
menu.SkipIntro.help: Skips startup logos. Story movies still play. Restart the game to apply.
textlanguage.description: Language of the fix's own texts. Auto follows the game's language.
WindowMode.description: Fullscreen, a framed window at the chosen resolution, or borderless at the monitor resolution. Restart the game to apply a window mode change.
ConfineCursor.description: Keep the cursor inside the game window while the game is active. It is released when the game loses the focus, while the window is moved and at once when this is turned off.
checkupdates.description: Checks for a new fix version once when enabled. A notice appears in Settings; FusionFixHub opens after the game exits if it is installed. Off makes no network request.
update.availablehub: An update for Psi-Ops Fusion Fix is available. FusionFixHub will open after you exit the game.
update.availablesite: An update for Psi-Ops Fusion Fix is available at fusionfix.io.
FPSLimit.description: Maximum frames per second. 0 adds no limit, -1 uses the monitor refresh rate, or choose 30 to 1000. The recommended limit is 60; higher rates need gameplay checks.
PauseOnFocusLoss.description: Pause the game and its sound while its window isn't active. Off keeps it running in the background.
HudAspectRatioConstraint.description: Auto uses the whole screen width: HUD elements at the sides go to the screen's edges. A ratio such as 16:9 keeps them in a centered box of that aspect.
CutsceneBorders.description: Both keeps the original cinematic frame with borders at any aspect ratio. Off removes the borders and fills the screen, showing more at the sides on wider screens. Letterbox and Pillarbox retain only the named borders.
AnimatedCutsceneBorders.description: Keep the game's sliding top and bottom borders. Off switches them instantly.
